# Copilot project instructions

Before designing or implementing the site, read and follow:

1. [Website architecture](../docs/website-architecture.md) for approved pages
   and URLs.
2. [Keyword map](../docs/keyword-map.md) for search intent and keyword ownership.
3. [SEO, AEO, and technical strategy](../docs/seo-strategy.md) for content and
   implementation requirements.

The initial documents contain proposals, not owner approvals. Ask the project
owner to approve the architecture, keyword ownership, and strategy before
starting site design or implementation. Do not treat proposed entries as
approved.

Create, remove, rename, or redirect pages only when the change is explicitly
approved and reflected in the architecture and keyword map. Do not invent
routes, locations, services, property details, business claims, keyword
metrics, or search rankings. When requirements or approvals are missing, ask
the owner instead of making strategic decisions.

For any requested change that affects these documents, obtain owner approval
and keep all three consistent. Implement only the approved scope, preserve
existing behavior where applicable, and verify relevant SEO and technical
requirements before considering the work complete.
